{{Quote|She thought we were too young to go by ourselves. She worries a lot.|[[Jez (Human)|Jez]] on their mother|<ref name="Rebel Force: Hostage" />}}
This '''female Human''' was the mother of [[Lan (Human)|Lan]] and resided on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. The day before Alderaan's [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]], Lan and his friends, [[Mazi]] and [[Jez (Human)|Jez]], went to [[Delaya/Legends|Delaya]] to watch a [[Smashball/Legends|smashball]] tournament. Despite Lan's young age and her worrisome nature, Lan's mother was convinced by Mazi to allow them to go. She later died along with her [[Lan's father|husband]] when Alderaan was destroyed.<ref name="Rebel Force: Hostage" />
